core_record.topic: Three levels of HTTP compression: file formats, end-to-end message body, adjacent-node connections.
core_record.main_judgment: Appropriate compression reduces data transfer and improves site performance; choose by level and acceptable quality, avoid redundant general compression on compressed files.
necessary_support_and_conditions: File-format section: lossless/lossy distinction, GIF/PNG/JPEG/WebP, quality-size tradeoff, overhead can outweigh recompression savings.
End-to-end section: server compresses body which stays unchanged in transit; Accept-Encoding, Content-Encoding and Vary; text-oriented algorithms and existing server configuration mechanisms.
Hop-by-hop section: compression between adjacent nodes, differing per link; TE and Transfer-Encoding; rare, mainly proxy configuration; chunking allows transmission before total length is known.
